what: where the per-space normalization statistics come from, at the low point
note: stage 3 normalizes the candidates it returned; the Vespa rank profile is given statistics over each whole space. At a fixed candidate budget that protocol difference is worth about 0.10, which is why the simulation reports 0.38 for the single-field case and Vespa reports 0.48. The whole-space statistics are not an expensive oracle: a few hundred sampled documents per space land within 0.001 of using every one.
